dunning_jobs_cancel_reason_check.name: dunning_jobs_cancel_reason_check
dunning_jobs_cancel_reason_check.value:
("dunning_jobs"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("dunning_jobs"."cancel_reason" is not null)
        and ("dunning_jobs"."cancel_reason" is null or "dunning_jobs"."cancel_reason" in ('settled', 'void', 'student_disabled', 'tenant_disabled', 'superseded', 'claim_pending'))

invoice_lines_not_charged_reason_check.name: invoice_lines_not_charged_reason_check
invoice_lines_not_charged_reason_check.value:
("invoice_lines"."not_charged_reason" is not null) = ("invoice_lines"."kind" = 'session' and not "invoice_lines"."charged")
        and ("invoice_lines"."not_charged_reason" is null or "invoice_lines"."not_charged_reason" in ('excused_not_charged', 'unexcused_not_charged', 'cancelled', 'makeup', 'not_marked'))

invoices_paid_status_check.name: invoices_paid_status_check
invoices_paid_status_check.value:
case "invoices"."status"
        when 'partially_paid' then "invoices"."paid_amount" > 0 and "invoices"."paid_amount" < "invoices"."total_amount"
        when 'paid' then "invoices"."paid_amount" >= "invoices"."total_amount"
        when 'pending_confirmation' then "invoices"."paid_amount" < "invoices"."total_amount"
        else "invoices"."paid_amount" = 0 end

invoices_installment_check.name: invoices_installment_check
invoices_installment_check.value:
("invoices"."installment_no" is null) = ("invoices"."installment_count" is null)
        and ("invoices"."installment_no" is null or ("invoices"."installment_count" between 1 and 36 and "invoices"."installment_no" between 1 and "invoices"."installment_count"))

invoices_issue_fields_check.name: invoices_issue_fields_check
invoices_issue_fields_check.value:
case when "invoices"."status" = 'draft'
        then "invoices"."code" is null and "invoices"."transfer_note" is null and "invoices"."qr_payload" is null and "invoices"."payout" is null and "invoices"."issued_at" is null
        else "invoices"."code" is not null and "invoices"."transfer_note" is not null and ("invoices"."qr_payload" is not null or "invoices"."total_amount" = 0) and "invoices"."payout" is not null and "invoices"."issued_at" is not null end

invoices_void_fields_check.name: invoices_void_fields_check
invoices_void_fields_check.value:
("invoices"."status" = 'void') = ("invoices"."voided_at" is not null and "invoices"."void_reason" is not null)
        and ("invoices"."status" = 'void' or ("invoices"."voided_at" is null and "invoices"."void_reason" is null))

payment_claims_resolved_check.name: payment_claims_resolved_check
payment_claims_resolved_check.value:
("payment_claims"."status" = 'pending') = ("payment_claims"."resolved_at" is null)
        and ("payment_claims"."resolved_at" is null) = ("payment_claims"."resolved_by" is null)
        and ("payment_claims"."resolved_at" is null) = ("payment_claims"."resolved_by_name" is null)
        and ("payment_claims"."status" = 'confirmed') = ("payment_claims"."payment_id" is not null)
        and ("payment_claims"."status" = 'rejected') = ("payment_claims"."reject_reason" is not null)
        and ("payment_claims"."reject_reason" is null or char_length("payment_claims"."reject_reason") between 1 and 300)

payments_void_fields_check.name: payments_void_fields_check
payments_void_fields_check.value:
("payments"."voided_at" is null) = ("payments"."void_reason" is null) and ("payments"."voided_at" is null) = ("payments"."voided_by" is null)
        and ("payments"."voided_at" is null) = ("payments"."voided_by_name" is null)
        and ("payments"."void_reason" is null or char_length("payments"."void_reason") between 1 and 300)

revenue_ledger_amount_check.name: revenue_ledger_amount_check
revenue_ledger_amount_check.value: case "revenue_ledger"."kind" when 'payment' then "revenue_ledger"."amount" between 1 and 100000000000 else "revenue_ledger"."amount" between -100000000000 and -1 end

student_ledger_amount_check.name: student_ledger_amount_check
student_ledger_amount_check.value: "student_ledger"."debit" between 0 and 100000000000 and "student_ledger"."credit" between 0 and 100000000000 and ("student_ledger"."debit" > 0) <> ("student_ledger"."credit" > 0)

classes_fee_rules_check.name: classes_fee_rules_check
classes_fee_rules_check.value: "classes"."fee_rules" is null or ("classes"."fee_type" is not null and jsonb_typeof("classes"."fee_rules") = 'object' and pg_column_size("classes"."fee_rules") < 4096)

memberships_branch_requires_tenant.name: memberships_branch_requires_tenant
memberships_branch_requires_tenant.value: "memberships"."branch_id" is null or "memberships"."tenant_id" is not null

memberships_scope_check.name: memberships_scope_check
memberships_scope_check.value:
("memberships"."role" in ('parent', 'student')) = ("memberships"."tenant_id" is null)
        and ("memberships"."student_id" is null or "memberships"."role" = 'student')
